'''Aleen Minor''', often inaccurately referred to as just '''Aleen''', was a temperate [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories. A colony world of the [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[Species/Legends|species]], Aleen Minor was often mistaken as the species' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].

==Description==
Aleen Minor was a world located in the Inner Rim. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] and had a harsh and difficult environment. The extremely fast predators known as [[sagcatcher]]s represented a constant threat for the Aleena.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

Aleena appreciated speed sports very much so they built many arenas on Aleen Minor.<ref name="FaDCR" /> The [[Aleen Classic]], a popular [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] event, was held on the world.<ref name="BonkikDatabank">{{DB|character|paxbonkik|Bonkik, Pax}}</ref>

Aleena from Aleen Minor were also known as master crafter of artisanal [[laroon wood]], marble, and granite furniture.<ref name="FaDCR" />

==History==
{{Quote|Analysts foresee Yag'Dhul as a likely launching point for major offensives along the Rimma Trade Route, to supplement forces in the Seswenna and Sluissi sectors. Aleen and Atzerri, worlds that have so far remained neutral, are also likely candidates for liberation missions, while the Republic world of Malastare seems likely to become a major battlefront.|[[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]]|<ref name="Insider76">{{InsiderCite|76|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:3:21 Edition}}</ref>}}
Aleen Minor was founded by members of the [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] species during the an expansionist era experienced on [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]]. Taking with them the high technologies developed on their homeworld, Aleen Minor developed further as Aleen entered into a self-imposed end to technological advancement and eliminated all industry on their world.<ref name="NoP" /> Aleen Minor was discovered by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] scouts during the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Granted direct representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="BoggDatabank" />

Over the years aligned with the Senate, the world welcomed the construction of a [[Jedi chapter house (Aleen Minor)|chapter house]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="HNN53" /> The world was represented by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bogg Tyrell/Legends|Bogg Tyrell]] during the waning days of the Republic.<ref name="BoggDatabank" /> Aleen Minor remained neutral during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Insider76" />

Aleen Minor was the homeworld of [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] pilot [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]].<ref name="TNEGtC" /><ref name="RattsDatabank">{{DB|character|rattstyerell|Tyerell, Ratts}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Due to the discrepancies between the previous sources and the planet described in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] TV series, [[Jason Fry]] stated that those Aleen are two different worlds. The old Aleen is now Aleen Minor and the new is [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]]. This was later formalized in [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref>{{JCFCite|url=posts/31933546|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfy]]|date=2011-10-08|time=5:15 AM}}</ref> The [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]] mistakenly places both Aleen and Aleen Minor in the Mid Rim, and claims that the Jedi chapter house on Aleen Minor is on Aleen.
